title: Prove both run.rs plain sends carry --behavior interrupt
action: Per decision ebda4a72. Independently check the pc17-1 change: read the diff of packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/paseo.rs and confirm send_argv now yields send <id> --behavior interrupt --no-wait -- <text>. Then find the existing tests in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs (its tests module) that drive the Paseo round path with a fake PaseoCli that records calls: one that sends the next-round brief pointer (send_argv near line 4444) and one that sends the idle nudge (send_argv near lines 5000/5053). Add or extend assertions so a test fails if the recorded send call for the round pointer, and for the idle nudge, lacks the pair --behavior interrupt or carries --behavior queue. Assert on the recorded argv the fake CLI saw, not on send_argv directly. If no existing fake reaches one of those paths, write the smallest new test that does, reusing the module's existing fakes. Run the verify command and record its output. No code comments.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee herding::run
